name: EdgeEnhancementVolumeStyle
definition: A volume rendering style that enhances edges by darkening voxels based on their orientation relative to the view direction. Perpendicular voxels are coloured by edgeColor, parallel voxels are unchanged.
summary: EdgeEnhancementVolumeStyle is a non-composable render style that enhances structural edges by darkening voxels based on geometric orientation relative to the view direction.
